📦 Packing

In Packing, you make sure products are packed correctly before they are shipped.

Your tasks include:

- Checking products;
- Packing orders;
- Adding labels and documents;
- Preparing shipments for transport.

🚜 Picking (Reach Truck)

As a Reach Truck Operator, you collect products for customer orders.

Your tasks include:

- Picking orders;
- Moving products from warehouse locations;
- Operating the reach truck safely;
- Replenishing stock when needed.

No reach truck certificate yet? No problem. Olympia can help you get one.

✅ Consolidation

In Consolidation, you make sure orders are complete before they leave the warehouse.

Your tasks include:

- Checking orders;
- Combining products into complete shipments;
- Checking quantities and quality;
- Releasing orders for shipment.
